name: plotkeeper-guard
description: Fail-closed production release guard for Plotkeeper-managed Codex work

interface.shortDescription: Block unreviewed release commands before side effects.
interface.longDescription: Plotkeeper Guard validates an active production goal contract and an independent candidate-bound DEPLOY_READY PASS receipt before Codex can run push, merge, deploy, or repository-metadata mutation commands.
interface.defaultPrompt: Inspect Plotkeeper Guard status and explain any blocked release action.
